newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha finely balanced and business slow.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha finely balanced and business slow.

text.p: NWE naphtha was a touch firmer on Monday, but the market was slow with little liquidity.
Dealers said it was balanced between tightish supplies and hence support for higher prices and unpressured end-users unwilling to trade at current levels.
Cargoes were talked in a wide range between $189 right up to $194 cif NWE.
"The wide spread reflects the current illiquidity," said one dealer.

Swaps were attracting more interest with August sold at $191.00 at its high point before easing back to $190.00 with $190.75 and $190.50 traded in between. The backwardation into September widened with swaps trading at $188.25.
